title: Jiuwei Xiaozhi Decoction Alleviates High-Fat Diet-Induced MASLD by Suppressing Hepatic SREBP2-Driven Cholesterogenesis and Restoring PPARalpha-Mediated Fatty Acid Oxidation.
authors: Ma, Youcheng; Gao, Xinrui; Wang, Ji; Li, Lingru; Huang, Zhen; Li, Fangli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对脂肪肝的疗效，分子对接仅作为辅助验证，核心是代谢通路与湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Jiuwei Xiaozhi Decoction (JWXZ) is a nine-herb traditional Chinese medicine formula clinically used for hepatic steatosis and dyslipidemia, but its chemical basis and pharmacological mechanisms in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) remain incompletely defined. The chemical profile of JWXZ was characterized by UHPLC-HRMS/MS. Its therapeutic effects were evaluated in a high-fat diet (HFD)-induced mouse model of MASLD, followed by hepatic transcriptomic analysis, network pharmacology, molecular docking, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence validation. UHPLC-HRMS/MS identified 178 chemical constituents in JWXZ, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, flavonoid glycosides, alkaloids, isoflavones, and coumarins. In HFD-fed mice, JWXZ attenuated body weight gain, white adipose accumulation, dyslipidemia, hepatic triglyceride and cholesterol accumulation, serum transaminase elevation, and hepatic steatosis, while improving glucose tolerance and partially restoring whole-body metabolic flexibility. Hepatic transcriptomics identified 124 HFD-dysregulated genes reversed by high-dose JWXZ, with prominent enrichment in cholesterol and sterol biosynthesis, endoplasmic reticulum proteostasis, oxidative stress response, and PPARalpha-related lipid handling. Integrated transcriptomic and network pharmacology analyses further identified 157 shared targets and 18 overlapping pathways, converging mainly on cholesterol metabolism and PPAR signaling. Protein-level validation showed that JWXZ suppressed SREBP2 proteolytic activation, reduced nuclear SREBP2 abundance, and downregulated HMGCR, SQLE, and PCSK9, indicating inhibition of the hepatic cholesterogenic program. In parallel, JWXZ restored nuclear PPARalpha abundance and CPT1A expression, consistent with reactivation of fatty acid oxidation. JWXZ also reduced hepatic EGFR phosphorylation and lowered hepatic and circulating TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, and MCP-1 levels. Molecular docking provided supportive evidence for potential interactions between representative JWXZ constituents and key regulators, including naringin-HMGCR, chlorogenic acid-SQLE, rhoifolin-PPARalpha, and rhoifolin-SREBP2. These findings suggest that JWXZ ameliorates HFD-induced MASLD mainly by rebalancing hepatic lipid metabolism through coordinated suppression of SREBP2-mediated cholesterogenesis and restoration of PPARalpha-mediated fatty acid oxidation, with associated attenuation of EGFR-linked inflammatory responses.
abstract_zh: 九味消脂汤（JWXZ）是一种由九味中药组成的传统中药方剂，临床上用于治疗肝脂肪变性和血脂异常，但其在代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）中的化学基础及药理机制尚未完全阐明。通过UHPLC-HRMS/MS表征了JWXZ的化学轮廓。在高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的MASLD小鼠模型中评估了其治疗效果，随后进行了肝脏转录组分析、网络药理学、分子对接、Western blotting和免疫荧光验证。UHPLC-HRMS/MS在JWXZ中鉴定出178种化学成分，包括酚酸、黄酮类、黄酮苷类、生物碱、异黄酮和香豆素类。在HFD喂养的小鼠中，JWXZ减轻了体重增加、白色脂肪积累、血脂异常、肝脏甘油三酯和胆固醇积累、血清转氨酶升高及肝脂肪变性，同时改善了葡萄糖耐量并部分恢复了全身代谢灵活性。肝脏转录组学鉴定出124个由HFD失调的基因被高剂量JWXZ逆转，这些基因显著富集于胆固醇和甾醇生物合成、内质网蛋白质稳态、氧化应激反应及PPARα相关脂质处理通路。整合转录组和网络药理学分析进一步识别出157个共享靶点和18条重叠通路，主要汇聚于胆固醇代谢和PPAR信号通路。蛋白质水平验证显示，JWXZ抑制了SREBP2蛋白水解激活，降低了核内SREBP2丰度，并下调了HMGCR、SQLE和PCSK9，表明其抑制了肝脏胆固醇生成程序。同时，JWXZ恢复了核内PPARα丰度和CPT1A表达，与脂肪酸氧化的再激活一致。JWXZ还降低了肝脏EGFR磷酸化，并降低了肝脏及循环中的TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β和MCP-1水平。分子对接为JWXZ代表性成分与关键调控因子之间的潜在相互作用提供了支持性证据，包括柚皮苷-HMGCR、绿原酸-SQLE、野漆树苷-PPARα和野漆树苷-SREBP2。这些发现表明，JWXZ主要通过协调抑制SREBP2介导的胆固醇生成和恢复PPARα介导的脂肪酸氧化来重新平衡肝脏脂质代谢，从而改善HFD诱导的MASLD，并伴随EGFR相关炎症反应的减弱。
